commands:
ipset --create f2b-o-a-iptables-ipset-proto4 maxelem 65536 iphash
for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
{ <iptables> -C $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -m set --match-set f2b-o-a-iptables-ipset-proto4 src -j <blocktype> >/dev/null 2>&1; } || { <iptables> -I $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -m set --match-set f2b-o-a-iptables-ipset-proto4 src -j <blocktype>; }
done; done

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -m set --match-set f2b-o-a-iptables-ipset-proto4 src -j <blocktype>
done; done
ipset --flush f2b-o-a-iptables-ipset-proto4
ipset --destroy f2b-o-a-iptables-ipset-proto4

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -m set --match-set f2b-o-a-iptables-ipset-proto4 src -j <blocktype>
done; done
